new.front: In a module, what does a leading underscore on a function or variable name indicate?
new.back: That it's private — by convention only; nothing enforces it

new.front: What does an all-uppercase variable name indicate?
new.back: A constant — again a convention that nothing enforces

new.front: What does .split() split on, by default and otherwise?
new.back: Whitespace by default — or whatever separator you pass it
['2026', '10', '23'] — a list of the pieces between each separator
